speech.heard: In Qatar, material well-being hits $126,290 international dollars. In Burundi, it is $1,250. Qatar has 101 times the buying power found in Burundi. These figures convert different currencies and eliminate the differences in price levels between countries. The USA has $89,490 international dollars per person. China hits $29,160. The highest income places on Earth, Qatar, Norway, Ireland, Switzerland, and the USA. India stands at $11,600 international dollars. How much income does your country average?
